title: Period, Symmetry, and Graph of s = csc(t/2)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Graph the function s = \csc(t/2) in the ts-plane. Find its fundamental period and identify the symmetry of its graph.

steps.title: Calculate the Fundamental Period
steps.explanation: The cosecant function has base period 2*pi. Dividing 2*pi by the coefficient 1/2 of t yields a fundamental period of 4*pi.

steps.title: Identify Vertical Asymptotes and Extrema
steps.explanation: Vertical asymptotes occur at even multiples of pi where sin(t/2) = 0. Local minima of 1 occur at t = pi + 4k*pi and local maxima of -1 occur at t = 3*pi + 4k*pi.
steps.why: csc(t/2) = 1/sin(t/2) blows up at zeros of sin(t/2) and touches +/-1 at extrema of sin(t/2).

steps.title: Verify Symmetry About the Origin
steps.explanation: Because sine is odd, its reciprocal cosecant is also odd, meaning the graph is symmetric about the origin.
steps.why: The reciprocal of an odd function satisfies f(-t) = -f(t) on its entire domain.
